text: 成大生物公告，拟使用部分超募资金以集中竞价交易方式回购公司股份，回购资金总额不低于人民币2500万元（含），不超过人民币5000万元（含），回购价格不超过30元/股（含）。本次回购股份拟全部注销并相应减少公司注册资本。按回购价格上限测算，预计回购股份数量约为83.33万股至166.67万股，约占公司总股本的比例为0.20%至0.40%。回购期限为自股东会审议通过本次回购股份议案之日起12个月内。
text_en: Chengda Biotech announced that it plans to use part of its excess raised funds to repurchase company shares through centralized bidding, with total repurchase funds of no less than 25 million yuan (inclusive) and no more than 50 million yuan (inclusive), and a repurchase price of no more than 30 yuan per share (inclusive). The repurchased shares are all intended to be cancelled, with a corresponding reduction in the company's registered capital. Based on the upper limit of the repurchase price, the expected number of repurchased shares is approximately 833,300 to 1,666,700 shares, accounting for approximately 0.20% to 0.40% of the company's total share capital. The repurchase period is within 12 months from the date the shareholders' meeting approves the repurchase proposal.
